arguments.recommended_next_step: Review the source of the malformed rows to prevent future occurrences. Continue investigating the root cause of the jobs failing and address it to prevent similar issues in the future.
arguments.summary: The connection pool refresh did not directly cause the p99 latency spike, but there were 47 malformed rows in the failed_jobs table which were blocking the retry queue. Deleting these rows unblocked the queue immediately. The failed_jobs table has been exported for the postmortem.
